build_dla_fpn3_backbone: build a DLA-34 bottom-up backbone with FPN top-down pathway for object detection
build_dla_fpn5_backbone: build a DLA-34 backbone with FPN and extra P6 P7 levels for RetinaNet
build_dlaup_backbone: build a DLA-34 backbone with top-down IDA feature fusion using conv or deformable conv nodes
create_DLA: create a Deep Layer Aggregation network with configurable levels channels and block types
create_DLAUP: create a DLA top-up module that fuses multi-scale features via IDAUp with optional deformable conv
